title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Title: Full Stack Engineer
Location: MUST be hybrid and onsite 2x weekly in Mount Arlington, NJ-Locals only
Duration: 6 months initial contract
Client: MedPro
Pay rate: $55/hour c2c max
Visa: USC, GC, EADs Only
Mode of Interview: 2 rounds interview with final ONSITE and coding exercise as part of it.

Looking for a mid to senior level person, level II-III in a contract capacity that would be approximately 6 months long to help build and test capacity.

POSITION SUMMARY
EngagePro is MedPro's Healthcare Provider (HCP) engagement platform – a net-new, AI-first product built out of MedPro Labs and is now hardening toward a production launch. This role adds dedicated build capacity to accelerate that launch, with test engineering as an equal half of the mandate.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Deliver features end-to-end on EngagePro's modern, AI-first stack: Reacj front end, FastAPI services, PostgreSQL and MongoDB persistence.
  • Build the automated test foundation for launching product – unit, API, integration, and end-to-end coverage that lets the team ship quickly and safely.
  • Contribute to AI-in-product integration patterns as a core part of EngagePro's value.
JOB QUALIFICATIONS
The Build & Test Mandate:
  • This role is explicitly hybrid: a functional full-stack engineer who is also a strong test engineer.
  • You write the feature and the automated coverage that proves it.
  • On a launching product, test quality is what makes velocity safe.
Working Model (Contract):
  • Per MedPro's support model, contractors do not hold production access. Deployments and production operations pair through the full-time pod lead; your job is to make that pairing cheap — clean pipelines, feature flags, strong observability, and changes that are safe to ship.
  • AI-assisted development is the standard working mode.
  • A focused 6-month engagement aligned to the launch window, with extension evaluated against launch progress.
YEARS' EXPERIENCE
  • 4–7 years full-stack engineering on production SaaS.
TECHNOLOGY/SOFTWARE KNOWLEDGE
  • Strong on the modern stack: React and Python/FastAPI with PostgreSQL; MongoDB a plus.
  • Genuine test-engineering depth: pytest, Playwright, API and integration testing, and test design — not incidental coverage. This is a stated, weighted requirement for this role.
  • Fluency in AI-assisted development required: experience launching a net-new SaaS product and life-sciences exposure both preferred.
REQUIRED TRAVEL
10%
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.
  • The individual is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer screen and extensive reading.
  • The individual in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
  • The individual must be able to remain in a stationary position 70% of the time.
EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION
Bachelor of Science - Computer Science

You will work closely with backend engineers, architects, and mission stakeholders to build intuitive applications capable of processing and displaying large volumes of information in near real-time. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency patterns, API integration, and modern front-end development practices.

We use Svelte as its primary front-end framework. Prior Svelte experience is highly desired but not required for candidates with strong modern JavaScript framework expertise and a willingness to learn.

  • Build highly intuitive user experiences that support mission-critical situational awareness and collaboration workflows.
  • Develop efficient client-side applications capable of handling large data sets, concurrent requests, and near real-time information updates.
  • Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs, WebSocket services, and distributed backend systems.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers to consume services and leverage event-driven architectures, including Kafka-based data streams.
  • Implement performant asynchronous data loading strategies utilizing promises, concurrency patterns, and modern browser capabilities.
  • Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and scalability across multiple operating environments.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
  • Conduct code reviews and promote software engineering best practices.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to the overall growth of the engineering team.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Experience developing and deploying applications within Linux-based environments.
  • Strong experience building modern web applications and user interfaces.
  • Experience consuming and integrating RESTful web services and APIs.
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming concepts, including Promises, async/await patterns, concurrency, and parallel data processing.
  • Experience building applications that support near real-time data delivery and dynamic user experiences.
  • Understanding of distributed systems and how front-end applications interact with microservices architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical efforts and mentor junior engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or graduation from an accredited coding bootcamp with equivalent experience.
  • Must possess or be willing to obtain a CompTIA Security+ certification.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Svelte or other modern front-end frameworks.
  • Experience developing applications utilizing WebSockets and real-time communication technologies.
  • Familiarity with Kafka and event-driven architectures, including consuming and visualizing data originating from streaming platforms.
  • Experience supporting highly concurrent applications with complex data-loading requirements.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native deployment environments.
  • Experience delivering mission-critical applications within government, defense, intelligence, or other secure environments.

Sr Salesforce Administrator – Job Description
Role Summary
The Senior Salesforce Administrator is responsible for the governance, configuration, and ongoing optimization of the Salesforce platform. This role ensures high data integrity, system reliability, and alignment with business objectives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent thinker who exercises strong due diligence before executing platform changes, owns platform integrity end-to-end, and proactively identifies risks before they impact the business or data.
Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Governance
· Own and manage all aspects of Salesforce platform administration, including configuration, user access management, and data integrity
· Evaluate and execute change requests with strong due diligence and risk awareness
· Ensure all platform decisions do not introduce business, data, or compliance risk
· Maintain adherence to governance, security, and compliance standards at all times
· Perform independent critical thinking on all platform changes prior to execution
Stakeholder & Agile Delivery Partnership
· Partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technology teams to deliver scalable, well-governed solutions
· Analyze complex business requirements and translate them into Salesforce configurations and enhancements
· Support Agile delivery practices and actively participate in sprint ceremonies (standups, planning, retrospectives, demos)
· Provide POD support for stories requiring Salesforce Admin involvement
Data Analysis & Impact Assessment
· Perform historical and existing data analysis for records impacted by migration or platform changes
· Analyze metadata and transformation logic across systems
· Prepare and migrate legacy datasets for admin reconciliation and load activities
· Execute Data Mapping & Transformation Analysis
· Identify and scope automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve platform efficiency
Operational & Recurring Activities
· User Provisioning – manage provisioning requests in alignment with access and security standards
· Recurring Platform Updates – execute scheduled updates on a Daily / Monthly / Quarterly / Annual cadence, including:
o Business Change requests
o License and permission set reviews
o Scheduled data loads and reconciliation tasks
· Event Monitoring – proactively monitor platform events, flag anomalies, and escalate as appropriate
· Deployment Support – provide admin support for platform deployments as needed
· UAT Validation Support – assist with User Acceptance Testing for larger efforts when POD teams have limited bandwidth
· Quarterly Metrics & Reporting – produce and maintain a quarterly metrics dashboard covering:
o Event Monitoring trends and findings
o User metrics (active users, license utilization, access anomalies, login history)
o Data Health metrics (data quality scores, duplicate records, etc.)
Required Skills & Experience
· Hands-on, proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator in an enterprise environment (not simply familiarity)
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration (objects, validation rules, workflows, permissions, etc.) and third-party apps integration
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
· Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks, including use of JIRA and Confluence
· Experience with data analysis, data mapping, and cross-system data reconciliation
Core Competencies
Competency Description
Ownership & Accountability Takes full responsibility for platform integrity, decisions, and outcomes
Risk Awareness Proactively identifies and mitigates platform, data, and compliance risks
Attention to Detail Applies rigorous diligence to all configuration, data, and change activities
Stakeholder Collaboration Communicates clearly and builds trusted relationships across business and technology teams
Analytical Thinking Translates complex business needs into sound, scalable Salesforce solutions
Platform Balance Balances business agility with platform integrity and governance standards
Independent Judgment Exercises critical thinking and does not execute changes without proper validation
